notes.title: Carma 0.4 Update Notes
notes.content:
With the release of Carma getting closer, we have been hard at work adding new features for you to enjoy. We have more big features planned, but for now we hope you enjoy reading about these!

[b]New Vehicle- Bus![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40427364/e98877b3b2cd01410822072044b13fdf2a3af523.png[/img]

Experience a different playstyle using the new bus, a slower but stronger vehicle. With unique handling properties, the bus encourages players to throw their weight around and be more daring with the extra health the bus has.

[b]Reworked In-Game Store![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40427364/0f6bebcb376965929433fb44d41c9a4c7c834398.gif[/img]

The in-game store has got a fresh lick of paint with some fancy new effects and multiple different types of toolboxes. This should make spending your hard earned favour a much more enjoyable experience.

[b]Bug Fixes![/b]

Of course this would be here. We have worked hard on squashing lots of bugs to ensure that your experience with Carma is as smooth and problem free as possible. The best of which being whatever this was...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40427364/7d6a1debd7b2a4fb1429c3dfb3fe18f589dd50f6.png[/img]
